title: Maintaining Earliest Arrival Routes Across Timetable Revisions
grain: One changed scheduled connection or version marker in ordered MBTA archive copies
dataset: MBTA archived GTFS timetables for common service date 22 November 2024
question: Can a router repair a revised timetable and still return exactly the same earliest arrivals as rebuilding?
design: Apply calendar and date exceptions for one Friday to ten consecutive archived feeds. Extract trunk rail, selected bus lines and shuttles. A timetable connection scan handles remaining on board, boarding restrictions, transfer waiting, and times beyond midnight. Retain unaltered time prefixes and compare with full invalidation and a fresh oracle for all reachable stops.
boundary: The archive assigns each download a non-overlapping archive interval. This is a comparison of overlapping planned calendar service inside those files. Results concern scheduled travel in a selected network, with a stated same-station transfer buffer and no street-walking links.
redistribution: Derived MBTA schedule records with attribution to the Massachusetts Bay Transportation Authority; publisher terms apply.
